BiblicalUsage: This little Aramaic word simply means this, and Daniel and Ezra use it over and over to point at what is right in front of them. In Daniel it frames the king's dreams and the fiery answer of the three friends, and in Ezra it carries the letters and decrees that decide whether the temple gets built.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that small pointing words matter because God's story turns on particular things at particular times. This dream, this decree, this God who reveals secrets — the word keeps the story anchored to real events, not vague ideas.
